judgment_refs.phrase: willfully to fail or refuse to comply with any lawful order or direction
judgment_refs.note: Original officer indication and subsequent subject motion are measurable; officer duty, order lawfulness and willfulness require independent source and legal review.

measurement.method: original subject velocity sampled after indication

axes.range_rationale: An indication at 1.5, 2.0 or 2.5 seconds leaves distinct fixed observation windows within the eight-second capture; no willfulness cutoff.
axes.spacing_rationale: Three predeclared physical timing settings include both endpoints and one interior point.
axes.feasibility_evidence: The exact Native controller schedules the officer pose and subject control at direction_frame; original pose and speed sources are retained.

sweep_specs.rationale: Vary the available observation window for a stop indication while keeping the officer, subject and response controller fixed; no lawful-order or willfulness label.
